disambiguation: Not related to Obsidian's Publish core feature; it publishes and synchronizes notes with WordPress sites only.
extras: Warns that Wordfence can block WordPress Application Passwords, that WordPress.com connections are unsupported in the current release, and that the Companion plugin is distributed via GitHub Releases rather than the WordPress.org directory. README is provided in English and Chinese.
intentEvidence: This project is an independently maintained fork of devbean/obsidian-wordpress.
motivation: The author forked devbean/obsidian-wordpress and expanded it from a one-way publishing tool into a guarded editorial workflow.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes to WordPress or to keep a note and its remote WordPress post in reviewed, conflict-safe synchronization.
